full_name: James Sturm | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Journalism & Nonfiction Mary I. Bunting Institute Fellow The Center for Cartoon Studies
bio: James Sturm is the cofounder and director of the Center for Cartoon Studies. His comics address issues of faith, race, and American identity, and his graphic novel Off Season (Drawn and Quarterly, 2019) explores the intersection of the personal and political against the backdrop of the 2016 presidential election.
